cloudhook_unavailable.title: Car Stats Viewer: Nabu Casa cloudhook unavailable
cloudhook_unavailable.description:
{vehicle_name} is set to use a Nabu Casa cloud webhook, but one couldn't be created ({reason}). The regular local/external webhook URL is being used in the meantime, so data collection is unaffected.

No action needed: this clears itself automatically once Home Assistant Cloud connects, no reload required. If {reason} doesn't sound temporary (for example, Cloud isn't set up, or your Nabu Casa subscription lapsed), fix that directly, or turn off "Use a Nabu Casa cloud webhook" in Configure if you don't need it.
